question: What are the hosted builds.sr.ht VM size, job time limit and per-user concurrent job limit for a paid account?
why: man.sr.ht/builds.sr.ht, the manifest reference, the installation page, the billing FAQ and the billing-change page state none of the three; only the open-source defaults (2 CPUs, 4096 MB, timeout=45m) and the SSH message 'terminated 4 hours from now' exist. A paid account's builds page or support would show them: behind a sign-up.
